item.desc: This measurement provides the volume of a data burst, excluding the data transmitted in the TTI when the buffer is emptied. A sample for ThpVolDl is the data volume, counted on PDCP SDU level, in Bytes. successfully transmitted (acknowledged by UE) in DL for one E-RAB during a sample of ThpTimeDl. It shall exclude the volume of the last piece of data emptying the buffer. For small data bursts, ThpVolDl is the data volume, counted on PDCP SDU level, in Bytes successfully transmitted in any given TT. Unit is in Bytes (89953)

item.desc: This counter provides the total number of transmitted data in kilobyte contained in the uplink RTP-Mux packet that is sent to the BVG. The total number of octets includes the application payload and IPsec protocol header (ESP) or (where IPsec is employed in tunnel mode) IPsec protocol header (ESP) and UDP+IP encapsulation headers. The application payload consists of the RTP payload, RTP header, RTP-Mux header and UDP+IP header. The IPsec protocol (ESP) and UDP+IP encapsulation header octets are currently estimated.
